tier2Rule: FOLLOW (tier 2): 30+ finished tips on 10+ days at a horizon; in both date halves beats the average stock after 1.2% stress cost, beats the S&P 500, positive without its 2 best tips, t >= 2.5. FADE (tier 2): both halves worse than the average stock, t <= -2.5, still worse without its 2 worst. First judgement frozen.
rule: FADE: 10+ finished tips on 5+ days and t <= -2 vs the average stock at 5 or 20 sessions; its tips become AVOID for 20 sessions. LISTEN (information only): t >= +2 with the same counts. Never a buy rule.

firstRun.note: per source: the first judged verdict, never overwritten

latest.label: MONITORING ONLY: a later run on newer data. It is NOT a new verdict and changes nothing; the verdict is firstRun (frozen at the first complete run, never overwritten).
